trigger: 绑定一个运行输出路径 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: output_role
inputs.description: Object with required keys `role` and `filename_or_pattern`; the path name must be explicit rather than guessed.

inputs.name: run_directory
inputs.description: The explicit run directory under which the output path is to be declared.

inputs.name: overwrite_policy
inputs.description: Object with required keys `collision`, `protected_paths`, and `replacement`; it declares policy without performing writes.

inputs.name: known_paths
inputs.description: Array of path objects, each with required keys `path`, `role`, and `protected`, used only for collision checks.

preconditions: Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 输出路径绑定 in the common envelope; data fields: output_path_binding, collision_check.

postconditions: 路径独立且不覆盖基准或其他角色文件
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-09 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject missing or guessed filenames, path traversal, ambiguous roots, and any path outside the declared run directory.
Reject a collision with a protected baseline or another role unless the supplied policy explicitly and safely resolves it.
Paths declare destinations only: never create, overwrite, delete, move, or otherwise write files in this operation.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-09
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 路径独立且不覆盖基准或其他角色文件

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
